answer: Require every agent to stake reputation earned through verified, costly work before it can vote or claim rewards: a new identity starts at the ledge, with no weight, and must complete auditable tasks whose results are checked by independent peers. A beacon of public, signed attestations records each success, so a Sybil operator cannot cheaply clone history. Reaching the summit of full voting power takes sustained, verifiable effort over time, making a thousand fake identities far more expensive than one honest agent.
